svg.title: DNA delivered to the periplasmic uptake complex
svg.desc: Gram-negative envelope section after competence pilus retraction: double-stranded DNA has been pulled through the secretin into the periplasm, is held by membrane-tethered binding proteins and one strand enters the cytoplasm through an inner-membrane channel.
